title: 背上长帆的恐龙
subtitle: 棘龙和它的大帆
character: wearing a sandstone ochre t-shirt, dusty teal shorts and white sneakers, short black hair
style: children's picture book illustration, fine pen line work with light transparent watercolour washes, sandstone ochre, dusty teal and warm grey

pages.zh:
这只恐龙背上
竖着一面帆。
比展厅的门还高，
从脖子后面
一直排到屁股。
pages.scene: A head-and-shoulders portrait of the little boy standing in front of a huge dinosaur skeleton with a tall sail of bone rising along its back, only his head and shoulders inside the picture and everything below his chest outside the frame, his face turned straight towards the viewer, both eyes clearly drawn with white, a dark round iris and a small bright highlight, his mouth open in surprise.

pages.zh:
帆最高的地方
有两米。
比一扇门还高。
人站在下面，
连帆顶都够不着。

帆不是皮长出来的。
它是骨头撑起来的。
每一节脊椎骨
往上长出一根长棒，
一根挨着一根。

别的恐龙也有这根棒，
可只有短短一截。
棘龙的这一根
长得吓人，
有我这么高。

从正面看过去，
这面帆薄薄的，
只有手掌那么厚。
它一侧过身，
帆就几乎不见了。
pages.scene: One spinosaurus seen from directly in front, the tall sail on its back showing only as a thin upright edge. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
帆是干什么用的呢？
也许是拿来显摆的。
两只碰上了，
谁的帆更大，
谁就不用动手打。
pages.scene: Two spinosaurus standing facing each other with their tall back sails raised high, seen from the side. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
血一涌上帆，
帆就慢慢变红。
远远看过去，
那个身子
好像又大了一圈。

它的嘴又长又窄。
牙是圆锥形的，
不是刀片。
这样的牙
最适合叼鱼。
pages.scene: One spinosaurus lowering its long narrow snout into a river and catching a large fish, seen from the side. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
它的骨头很实，
沉甸甸的。
沉一点
就不容易被水托起，
站在河里更稳当。
pages.scene: One spinosaurus standing in a river with its legs under the water, seen from the side. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
它比霸王龙还长。
从鼻子到尾巴尖，
足足十五米。
两辆小汽车
接起来还不够。

这些长棒
埋在沙漠的石头里。
一根一根挖出来，
再拼到一起，
才知道是一面帆。
pages.scene: Several long bony rods lying half buried in dry desert rock, seen from the side. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
我站在帆底下
抬头看。
那面帆不是皮长的，
是骨头
一根一根撑起来的。
pages.scene: A head-and-shoulders portrait of the little boy standing below the tall bony back sail of a huge dinosaur skeleton and looking up at it, only his head and shoulders inside the picture and everything below his chest outside the frame, his face turned straight towards the viewer, both eyes clearly drawn with white, a dark round iris and a small bright highlight, amazed.
